parameters.name: CredName
parameters.description:
The credential name. Valid values:

- 01: personal card or certificate
  - 0101: ID card
  - 0102: bank card
  - 0104: teacher qualification certificate
  - 0107: student ID card
- 02: business scenario
  - 0201: storefront photo
  - 0202: counter photo
  - 0203: scene photo
- 03: enterprise qualification
  - 0301: business license.

parameters.name: CredType
parameters.description:
The credential type. Valid values:

- 01: personal card or certificate
- 02: business scenario
- 03: enterprise qualification.

parameters.name: ImageContext
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded image. Specify one of imageUrl, imageFile, or imageContext.

parameters.name: ImageFile
parameters.description: The input stream of the image. Specify one of imageUrl, imageFile, or imageContext.

parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the image. Specify one of imageUrl, imageFile, or imageContext.

parameters.name: IsCheck
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable authoritative verification. Valid values:

- **0**: Disabled.
- **1**: Enabled.
><danger>Deprecated></danger>.
